name: Bikerei 701
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bikerei 701 in Alpbach, Austria**

Discover the cozy charm of **Alpbach**, a picturesque village nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. At **Bikerei 701**, we invite you to indulge in a delightful culinary experience with a focus on fresh, regional flavors.

Our menu features a variety of hearty dishes, from traditional **Tiroler** specialties to creative twists on classic recipes. Start your day with a warm, homemade breakfast or enjoy a leisurely brunch with our freshly baked pastries and artisanal bread.

For lunch, savor our hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** or a comforting bowl of homemade soup paired with a crisp **Tiroler** salad. In the evening, treat yourself to a delicious dinner featuring locally sourced ingredients, such as our famous **Tiroler Gröstl** or a perfectly grilled **Almwurst**.

Pair your meal with a selection of fine Austrian wines or craft beers from **Tirol**’s finest breweries. Whether you’re here for a quick bite or a relaxed meal, **Bikerei 701** promises an authentic taste of **Tirol** in every bite.

Located just a short stroll from the center of **Alpbach**, we’re the perfect spot to refuel after a day of exploring the stunning landscapes of the **Zillertal Alps**. Come visit us and experience the warmth and hospitality of **Tirol**!
